category_title: Fourth-grade students with behavioral challenges, poor work completion, and adequate literacy skills
scenario_title: Resistance to pull-out intervention and positive illusory bias
minimal_context: The student is in a small group intervention block selecting a daily behavioral goal and completing the Skills for Success Checklist.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at the daily schedule on the board. First, we need to complete the Skills for Success Checklist and select a behavioral goal for today, like respect, responsibility, cooperation, or best effort.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm just going to mark that I already have mastery of the vast majority of these skills. I'm giving myself a 90 percent because I have very little room for improvement.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to fill it out and pick one goal to focus on for our time together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't even want to be in this small group. The other kids in my homeroom are using this time to work on their homework and classwork, and I'm mad that I missed intervention in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to finish this activity before the block ends at 2:10. What would you change about this group to make it better?

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's look at the daily schedule on the board. First, we need to complete the Skills for Success Checklist and select a behavioral goal for today, like respect, responsibility, cooperation, or best effort.

STUDENT: I'm just going to mark that I already have mastery of the vast majority of these skills. I'm giving myself a 90 percent because I have very little room for improvement.

TUTOR: Just try your best to fill it out and pick one goal to focus on for our time together.

STUDENT: I don't even want to be in this small group. The other kids in my homeroom are using this time to work on their homework and classwork, and I'm mad that I missed intervention in the classroom.

TUTOR: We need to finish this activity before the block ends at 2:10. What would you change about this group to make it better?

STUDENT: Nothing except leaving.
